Abyss.concept: Lanternjaw: a deep-sea angler whose dangling lure is the light that paints its own face.

Aether.concept: Drifter: a dandelion-seed spirit riding the air on its silk crown; it bobs and sways like it is carried.

Amber.concept: Honey: a sleepy amber drop with a fossil leaf caught inside; light pools in its core and a drip stretches beneath.

Arcane.concept: Grimm: a floating spellbook with an eye on its cover; it flaps open to flash its pages and runes orbit its spine.

Aurora.concept: Vixen: a sitting sky-fox with a long pointed muzzle and a brush tail made of three aurora bands rippling in sequence.

Blizzard.concept: Flurry: a shaggy little yeti puffball; snowflakes orbit it and its fur ruffles in the wind.

Blood.concept: Ruby: a stout heart with stubby limbs; it beats lub-dub twice each loop and its light throbs with it.

Bloom.concept: Petal: a flower bud with a face; its petals breathe open and closed around it over the loop.

Celestial.concept: Astrolabe: an armillary sphere with a face at its core; its three rings turn on different axes.

Chrono.concept: Tock: a brass pocket-watch on two legs; its hands sweep the loop and it steps in time with the tick.

Comet.concept: Dash: a determined icy head racing forward; its tail streams back in long ribbons and sheds sparks.

Cosmic.concept: Astro: a little blob in a space helmet whose visor holds a slowly turning galaxy; it floats and waves.

Crystal.concept: Geode: a hermit crab carrying a crystal cluster for a shell; it snips its claws and the cluster catches its light.

Dream.concept: Snooze: a cloud-wool sheep fast asleep on a pillow; its breath rises as little glowing z's.

Earth.concept: Pebble: a mossy stone tortoise with a sprout on its shell; its head peeks out, looks around and tucks back in.

Eclipse.concept: Corona: a dark moon-disc with glowing eyes; the corona's flares turn behind it and a bright bead circles its rim.

Feather.concept: Plume: a round owlet made of soft layered feathers; it ruffles its wings and its ear tufts wiggle.

Fire.concept: Kindle: a teardrop flame imp whose three crown tongues flicker out of step; it sways and sheds embers.

Frostfire.concept: Ember-Rime: a wisp split down the middle, one half crackling ice and the other flame, each flickering its own way.

Glitch.concept: Bit: a blocky pixel critter that stutters; every few frames it tears into offset colour channels and snaps back.

Gold.concept: Doubloon: a cheeky coin with a face on one side and a star stamped on the other; it flips end over end.

Gravity.concept: Orbit: a tiny ringed planet with a sleepy face; two moons circle it, passing behind and in front.

Hologram.concept: Projection: a translucent wireframe sprite standing on a projector puck; scanlines climb through it.

Ice.concept: Nib: an ice-cube penguin with a snow cap; it waddles foot to foot and fogs the air with a breath.

Ink.concept: Quill: an ink-blot octopus holding a quill in one tentacle; it scribbles in the air while its arms curl.

Lightning.concept: Volt: a zig-zag imp with one wide eye; a live arc snaps between its horn tips and it twitches when it fires.

Lunar.concept: Nod: a crescent moon in a nightcap rocking like a cradle; little stars twinkle on and off around it.

Magma.concept: Slag: a squat boulder-toad with a cooled crust; molten cracks pulse with its breathing and lava drips off its chin.

Magnet.concept: Polly: a horseshoe magnet with a red and a blue pole for feet; it hops, and field lines pulse between its poles.

Mirror.concept: Glint: a hand mirror with a polite face in the glass; a bright reflection sweeps across it and it winks.

Nature.concept: Sprig: a round seed spirit with two broad leaf arms and a branching twig crown; it waves, and a leaf drifts down.

Nebula.concept: Drift: a gas-cloud jellyfish whose bell pulses as it swims; ribbon tendrils trail and ripple beneath.

Necrotic.concept: Rattle: a small skull pup with a ghost-green glow behind its eye sockets; its jaw chatters and its tail wags.

Neon.concept: Buzz: a cat drawn in a single bent neon tube on a dark backing; the tube hums and stutters when it warms up.

Plasma.concept: Orbi: a wobbling jelly orb with a churning core; two charged rings orbit it on crossed tilts.

Poison.concept: Toxi: a squat tree-frog with violet spots; its throat sac swells and glows, then it lets a drip fall.

Prism.concept: Spectra: a crisp glass prism with a face; a white beam enters one side and a moving rainbow fans out of the other.

Quantum.concept: Spin: a smiling nucleus with three electrons on crossed orbits, each looping at its own speed.

Radiance.concept: Seraph: a serene light-orb with downy wings and a halo; its wings beat slowly and the halo turns above it.

Rift.concept: Peek: a zipped tear in space standing on its own; it unzips to peek out with one eye, then seals shut.

Rune.concept: Menhir: a little standing stone on stubby legs; the rune carved in its face lights stroke by stroke, then fades.

Sand.concept: Dune: a lounging sphinx-cat in a striped headdress; its tail flicks and sand trickles through its paws.

Shadow.concept: Shade: a hooded wisp with nothing inside but two eyes; its tattered hem flutters and its lantern-eyes glint.

Smoke.concept: Curl: a lazy smoke-ring creature that slowly rolls over itself, trailing wisps from its rim.

Solar.concept: Sunny: a beaming sun-disc whose twelve rays turn a full step each loop while its warmth pulses outward.

Sonic.concept: Echo: a round pup with speaker-cone ears; every beat its ears thump and a ring of sound rolls off its call.

Spirit.concept: Wisp: a paper lantern on a hook with a friendly flame-spirit inside; it swings gently and the flame lights its paper.

Spore.concept: Puffcap: a squat mushroom with a spotted cap; it bounces on its stalk and puffs a little cloud of glowing spores.

Starlight.concept: Twinkle: a chubby five-point star that twirls on the spot; a twinkle hops from point to point.

Steam.concept: Puff: a round little teapot; its lid rattles on the boil and its spout breathes curling steam.

Steel.concept: Rivet: a riveted boxy robot with a visor face; its antenna bulb blinks and its head tilts to listen.

Tempest.concept: Grumble: a scowling thundercloud; rain streaks fall beneath it and every so often it flashes from within.

Thorn.concept: Prickle: a round cactus hedgehog with a single red flower; its spines bristle up and smooth down as it breathes.

Vital.concept: Pulse: a cheerful bean with a cross-shaped badge; a heartbeat trace runs across its belly in time with its glow.

Void.concept: Hollow: a cat-shaped window onto deep space; stars drift through its body and starlight rims its edges.

Water.concept: Ripple: a droplet axolotl; its six gill frills wave in sequence and bubbles rise past its grin.

Wind.concept: Zephyr: a puff-cheeked gust spirit with a curl on its crown; it puffs up, then blows streaming breezes.
